::: {#exm-sample-sd}
#### Variance and standard deviation of cholesterol in the WCGS

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
var(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE)
```

The sample variance is in (mg/dL)^2^,
and the sample standard deviation is in mg/dL,
like the cholesterol values themselves.
:::
